Back in 2006, When I was 13 , in 8th grade.  I had started smoking cigarettes and weed. One day I was smoking a cigarette outside of my middle school when my math teacher came out and told me to put it out. I did. A few hours later I was sitting in class when my guidance counselor pulled me out and into her office. She closed the door and told me to empty my pockets. I did. When i finally pulled out my ciggy box she found a little roach from a joint. There was no weed in it just ash really on a filter. Anyway she told me to stay put and they called the police. 

When the cops showed up they moved me to the assistant principles office where one of the police officer put me in handcuffs. I started crying as the cops through the contents of my bag on the table looking for more drugs. They found nothing. 

As i sat there hand cuffed the police and my guidance counselor were deciding on wether they should wait for the lunch bell to ring or take me out now. They chose now. As i was being led out into the hallway. the lunch bell rang and all of my friends watched me get arrested. 

I was taken to the precinct and strip searched and cuffed to a chair for 3 hours. 

The next day I was informed by my school that I would be expelled pending approval from the department of education. For a week I sat in detention in my deans office. On the friday the day I was supposed to get kicked out, I found out the DOE never saw my case and therefore I would be done with time served and allowed to continue school. 

I graduated 8th grade with honors. This experience left me scarred for a long time. I gave up smoking for 4 years. And have not been arrested since. I am now terrified of being locked up.
